# fco_projects (Data Source)

Lists the projects of the tenant the provider is configured with, optionally filtered by `name` and/or `labels`.

Access the results via `fco_projects.<name>.projects`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List the projects of the tenant the provider is configured with.
data "fco_projects" "all" {}

# Optionally filter by name and/or labels.
data "fco_projects" "dev" {
  labels = {
    env = "dev"
  }
}

output "projects" {
  value = data.fco_projects.all.projects
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `labels` (Map of String) Only return projects carrying all of these labels.
- `name` (String) Only return projects whose name matches this value.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) A content hash identifying the current set of listed projects.
- `projects` (Attributes List) The list of projects matching the given filters, scoped to the provider's tenant. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--projects))

<a id="nestedatt--projects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `projects`

Read-Only:

- `avatar_url` (String) The URL of the project avatar image.
- `created_at` (String) The timestamp (RFC 3339) when the project was created.
- `description` (String) A free-text description of the project. Must be shorter than 256 characters.
- `labels` (Map of String) A set of key/value label pairs assigned to the project.
- `name` (String) The name of the project. Must be between 2 and 128 characters and unique per tenant. The name is immutable; changing it destroys and recreates the project.
- `tenant` (String) The tenant the project belongs to.
- `updated_at` (String) Server-side last-modified timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `uuid` (String) The UUID of the project.
